note: Le couloir voûté (s02maison repaint 2026-10-22): the vaulted corridor (plan x 7-8, y 4-6) seen lengthwise facing north. Limestone ribbed vaults, white plaster walls, grey flags with a long runner, iron lanterns; LANDMARK the arched niche at the far end with a marble bust and model buildings (zoom z1). Left (west) wall: open door to the brick-and-chequer vestibule (R_entrance_04). Right (east) wall: open door to the deep-teal dining room with its chandelier (R_dining), a little stone balcony above it. Feminine left: girl holding up a giant golden key (clef), pony-head door handle (poignée), girl painting a sad face on a cardboard house front (façade), girl turning a key in the roaring lion lock of an oak chest (serrure). Masculine right: owl swooping under the vault (hall), man on a stepladder phoning the ceiling (plafond), man with an ice-cream cone on the balcony (balcon), man running towards the niche (corridor), tap dancer in a boater (rez-de-chaussée), man nailing a plank (plancher).
